name: HTML/CSS to Image MCP
description:
HTML/CSS to Image gives Claude a reliable browser-rendering service for creating images and PDFs. 

Render custom HTML/CSS, capture a live public webpage or selected element, or populate a reusable template with dynamic content.

Use it to create Open Graph images, social cards, product graphics, reports, invoices, certificates, webpage previews, and other assets—individually or in batches. The connector can also list, create, update, and inspect versions of saved HCTI templates.

HCTI manages the browser infrastructure and returns hosted assets, so you do not need to run Puppeteer, Playwright, or headless Chrome. Connect securely with your HTML/CSS to Image account through OAuth. 

Image generation and template operations are subject to your HCTI plan and available credits.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HTML/CSS to Image MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HTML/CSS to Image MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hcti.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HTML/CSS to Image MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HTML/CSS to Image MCP provides these MCP tools: check_usage, create_batch_images, create_image, create_template, create_templated_image, create_url_image, get_max_batch_size, list_proxies, list_storage_destinations, list_template_versions, list_templates, and update_template.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HTML/CSS to Image MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HTML/CSS to Image MCP in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does HTML/CSS to Image MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: HTML/CSS to Image MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops HTML/CSS to Image MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: HTML/CSS to Image MCP is developed by HTML/CSS to Image. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
